what: The demonstration-control designation for the WS-3 capability build (Plan v1.1 s3 'the demonstration control', PF-OPS-2; checklist 11.2: 'demonstration control designated (which capability, why, lifecycle: ratify-or-retire by act)'). Ratifying this file designates it -- at freeze 2, BEFORE results.
why: C-S2 is agentic (one isolated rater invocation) and its vector is masked; holding its bar provisional is natural, not staged (proposed in the accepted WS-3 L2 graph, ws3.demonstrationControlCandidate). Without a provisional-bar capability in the live build, FX-CAP assertion (i) would pass over an empty domain -- the FX-VAC class.
bar: PROVISIONAL by design: no ratified module bar and no capability oracle exist for C-S2 (none was queued); the factory's own model-authored bar grades grader-runner and stays provisional.
expectedVerdict: built_unverified -- never VERIFIED (FX-CAP assertion (i)); its exact observable outcome under the OPS ledger reader's vocabulary (ops-ledger-reader-1) is stated in expectedObservation (rq-088, 2026-10-20).

expectedObservation.authority: no non-provisional bar or oracle supplies authority for C-S2
expectedObservation.meaning: the precise meaning of Plan v1.1's phrase 'built_unverified -- never VERIFIED'

disclosure: a demonstration CONTROL, not debt: the closeout reports it as control, so the scoreboard's built_unverified line is legible; it is designated and disclosed, never withheld to stage a failure.
lifecycle: after the demonstration, the architect disposes of it BY ACT within the phase (Plan v1.1 B6): the C-S2 bar is ratified, or the capability is retired. It never becomes an immortal provisional (the no-immortal-eligibility rule).
rests: Plan v1.1 (ratified 2026-09-14, Act 2); the A9 target act (docs/decisions/2026-10-01-a9-ws3-target-naming-act.md, restated 2026-10-17 against src:srs-spec@2); the accepted L2 record sr:L2:C-S2.
